D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced the dates for four events: Golf
Tournament, October 13; Red Ribbon Rally, October 22; Halloween Spooktacular, October 31; Veterans
Day Concert, November 10.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that the Gateway Cities Regional Fiber Optic
project is getting stared in a couple of weeks; provided an LA County Sanitation District sewer trunk
improvement project update; announced that SCAG STBG Street Rehabilitation bids were received and
will be awarded at the next meeting; and provided an update on the City Hall re­roofing project.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, reported that she attended the International Council
of Shopping Centers Western Dealmaking event last week and met with shopping center owners; and
that a ribbon Cutting event was held for 3 Caprichos Cafe on October 3.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided an update on the YEP program, and announced that HDL
began handling the business license process.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, called on Sergeant Bitolas, who introduced the newest members of the
SAO Team, Deputy Rosales and Deputy Jackson.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio welcomed the new deputies to Hawaiian Gardens, and reported that she
attended the ribbon cutting ceremony for 3 Caprichos Cafe.
